notes.title: Release v5.29.4
notes.notes:
Release notes for version 5.29/28/27/26

[h1]Features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Audio Options page.
controls Animal, Announcer, Music, Sound Effects and Voice.
[*]Convert to use new Sound management asset.
[*]Remove the Chance fish since not fully impelemented.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Prevent hearing Monster Catch from far away players.
[*]Snagged Lure stops the Outboard from backing up.
[*]Increase the number of Voices for some Sound Effects.
[*]Lost dialog appears but Luse still there.
[*]Some Computer AI stopped fishing during game.
[*]Assorted fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release for version 5.25/24/23/22/21/20/19
notes.notes:
Release notes for version 5.25/24/23/22/21/20/19

Features:
[list]
[*]Available for Mac OS.
[*]New species for perch and longear.
[*]Single Player has been deprecated to save dev time.
[*]New JIT instructions.
[*]JIT instructions are now queued.
[*]Use last Lake selection when starting new game.
[*]GUI components should be independent of physics time
[/list]

Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]Sets destination to button click location.
[*]No automatic mode selection when starting game.
[*]Not back to fishing after Creature encounter.
[*]Feed Creature Dialog not using the Popup Manager.
[*]Unable to fish in outboard only mode.
[*]Creature not leaving hex after feeding.
[*]Cannot repair outboard prop certain situations.
[*]CandyBot fixes.
[*]Unable to fish after stopping with outboard.
[*]assorted fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Release notes for version 5.16 / 5.15 / 5.14
notes.notes:
Features:
[list]
[*]Use fish finder without leaving Cockpit.
[*]Add Tournament Rules step.
[*]Two new Catfish types.
[*]Add catfish bait chicken livers, hot dogs, and dough.
[*]Catfish favor stumps and rocks.
[*]JIT Instructions for fishing empty structures.
[*]JIT Instruction for spare prop.
[*]JIT instruction for Power Boost
[*]Don't change to trolling mode at end of game.
[*]Lake to get marker buoys.
[*]Computer AI better at changing Lures.
[*]Garbage will get snagged on an empty hook.
[*]Allow Multiple JIT instructions to appear at once.
[/list]
Bug Fixes:
[list]
[*]game never ended on some machines.
[*]Action points sometime don't reset at beginning of game.
[*]Fish should not bite on an empty hook
[*]Unable to leave Tackle Store.
[*]Creature moves away when fed.
[*]Bass should not eat chicken livers.
[*]Outboard goes forward when prop fixed.
[*]"GO fishing" button to get off the land and go fishing.
[*]Assorted minor fixes.
[/list]
